capabilities: Edit CSV/TSV cells inline with undo/redo
Sort, filter, and search across table columns
Detect file encodings and preserve them on save
Hide, reorder, freeze, and resize columns with per-file persistence
Insert and delete rows and columns via context menu
extras: README includes a privacy and permissions section stating it only reads/writes opened files and does not access the clipboard or network; also installable via BRAT from laofahai/obsidian-tablite; minimum supported Obsidian version is 1.5.0.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open or edit CSV/TSV files as tables; they show as raw text.
summary: CSV/TSV editor that opens tabular files as an editable spreadsheet-style table with virtual scrolling, sorting, filtering, and encoding detection.
